name: Ratio and Percentages
description: Turn percentages and ratios into tools for comparing prices, growth and exchange rates.

lessonNames.l4-multipliers: One multiplication instead of two steps
lessonNames.l5-rise-or-fall: Measuring a rise or a fall
lessonNames.l6-before-the-discount: Finding the price before the discount
lessonNames.l11-direct-or-inverse: When one goes up, does the other?
lessonNames.l12-best-buy: Rates, speeds and the best buy

lessonObjectives.l1-out-of-a-hundred: Read a percentage as a fraction of 100 and move between fractions, decimals and percentages.
lessonObjectives.l2-building-percentages: Find any percentage of an amount by combining 10%, 5% and 1%.
lessonObjectives.l3-what-percentage: Express one quantity as a percentage of another.
lessonObjectives.l4-multipliers: Increase or decrease an amount in one step with a decimal multiplier.
lessonObjectives.l5-rise-or-fall: Compute percentage change from the original value, not the new one.
lessonObjectives.l6-before-the-discount: Work back to an original amount by dividing by the multiplier.
lessonObjectives.l7-up-then-down: Show why equal percentage moves up and down do not cancel out.
lessonObjectives.l8-growth-on-growth: Apply a percentage change repeatedly and compare compound with simple interest.
lessonObjectives.l9-sharing: Split an amount in a given ratio by counting equal parts.
lessonObjectives.l10-scaling: Simplify ratios and scale quantities up or down in proportion.
lessonObjectives.l11-direct-or-inverse: Tell direct from inverse proportion and solve a problem with each.
lessonObjectives.l12-best-buy: Compare rates by converting them to a common unit.
lessonObjectives.l13-currencies: Convert money between currencies with a quoted rate and its inverse.
